F86 MOTION CONTROLLER – installation overview (Figure 1.1; labels translated from Vietnamese):
- Servopack / servo drivers (6 shown): each driver connects to one axis connector (CN10-CN15) with a servopack cable.
- Sensors, push buttons, limit switches and other inputs: connect to the input connectors (CN16, CN17, CN18).
- Output connector: switches a relay or drives a load below 1 A.
- Main spindle inverter: connect with pulse (PUL/DIR) or analog control; the connector can also drive a servo pack without Z-phase encoder feedback.
- Handwheel (MPG): connects with the handwheel cable.
- 24 V DC power supply to CN1; the machine frame ground must be connected.
- I/O Link expansion board: connected with the I/O-link cable (RS485).
- USB: through a USB extension cable. Data backup battery: CR2032. Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz antenna (optional). Buzzer on the rear panel.
summary_vi: Sơ đồ tổng quan lắp đặt F86: servo (6 trục), cảm biến/công tắc hành trình, ngõ ra relay/tải dưới 1A, biến tần trục chính, tay quay MPG, nguồn 24V DC, bo mở rộng I/O Link, USB, pin CR2032 và ăng-ten Wi-Fi 2.4GHz.

CN3 - RS485 port (D+, D-, FG) to the I/O Link expansion board.
Controller to board: CN3 (D+, D-, FG) connects to CN10 or CN11 of the IO_LINK_32_V1.1_0722 board (pins 5, 6 and FG) with a twisted pair; the shield connects to FG.
Board to the next device: CN10 / CN11 of the IO_LINK_32 board (pins 5, 6, FG) connect to D+, D-, FG of the next I/O Link device (IO_LINK_DEVICE).
D+ is the non-inverting differential signal, D- the inverting differential signal, FG connects the shield wire.
summary_vi: CN3 là cổng RS485 (D+, D-, FG) nối bo mở rộng I/O Link IO_LINK_32_V1.1_0722 qua CN10/CN11 của bo bằng cáp xoắn có bọc chống nhiễu; bo này nối tiếp được sang thiết bị I/O Link khác.

CN4 - inverter / spindle connector. Pins: D7-, D7+, P7-, P7+, GND, DA.V, GND, DA.I.
- P7- / P7+: differential PUL- / PUL+ output of axis 7; sends the pulse signal to an inverter, driver or servo.
- D7- / D7+: differential DIR- / DIR+ (direction) output of axis 7.
- DA.V: analog spindle control, voltage 0-10 V.
- DA.I: analog spindle control, current 4-20 mA.
The pulse output for the inverter is independent of the analog output. The analog outputs (0-10 V and 4-20 mA) are controlled simultaneously and cannot be separated.
summary_vi: CN4 điều khiển biến tần/trục chính: xung PUL/DIR của trục 7 (P7, D7), analog điện áp 0-10V (DA.V) và dòng 4-20mA (DA.I); hai ngõ analog được điều khiển đồng thời, không tách riêng.

section_title: 2.6 Inverter wiring for pulse and analog input
metadata: {"chunk_key": "I-07", "doc_title": "Installation manual", "doc_version": "2024-04-25", "printed_page_start": 19, "printed_page_end": 19, "extraction": "text_layer+vision", "parent_key": "I-06", "source_note": "Hình dùng nhãn DIR7/PUL7; Figure 2.1 ghi cùng chân là D6/P6."}
content:
Inverter wiring for pulse and analog input (Figure 2.6, CN4 to inverter / driver):
- DIR7- / DIR7+ connect to D- / D+ of the driver (DIR input), as a twisted pair.
- PUL7- / PUL7+ connect to P- / P+ of the driver (PUL input), as a twisted pair.
- GND connects to GND.
- DA.V (DAC output) connects to V_IN of the inverter (0-10 V speed reference).
- DA.I (DAC output) connects to I_IN of the inverter (4-20 mA speed reference).
- A second GND connects to GND of the inverter for the current signal.
Note: the pulse output is independent of the analog output; analog 0-10 V and 4-20 mA are controlled simultaneously and not separated.
summary_vi: Sơ đồ nối biến tần với F86: DIR7/PUL7 vào D-/D+ và P-/P+ của biến tần (cáp xoắn), DA.V vào V_IN (0-10V), DA.I vào I_IN (4-20mA), nối GND chung.

metadata: {"chunk_key": "I-08", "doc_title": "Installation manual", "doc_version": "2024-04-25", "printed_page_start": 7, "printed_page_end": 25, "extraction": "text_layer+vision", "source_note": "PORT TABLE của tài liệu (tr.6-11) đánh số cổng lệch 1 so với Figure 2.1 và các sơ đồ 2.2-2.8 (vd RS485 ghi CN2, trục 1 ghi CN9). content:
CN5 - MPG handwheel connector (DB15, 15 pins).
Pins 1/2 = A+/A-, pins 3/4 = B+/B- (A/B pulses from the handwheel); pins 5-13 = axis-select and multiplier switches; pin 14 = GND; pin 15 = +5V.
- 4-axis handwheel (has an emergency button): pin 5 not connected, pin 6 EMG, pin 7 axis A, pin 8 Z, pin 9 Y, pin 10 X, pins 11/12/13 = multiplier X1 / X10 / X100.
- 6-axis handwheel (no emergency button): pin 5 C, pin 6 B, pin 7 A, pin 8 Z, pin 9 Y, pin 10 X, pins 11/12/13 = X1 / X10 / X100.
Each handwheel type has three wiring variants for the A/B output signal: differential, NPN, PNP (sections 2.6.1-2.6.6).
summary_vi: Cổng CN5 (DB15) nối tay quay MPG: chân 1-4 là xung A/B, chân 5-13 chọn trục và bội số X1/X10/X100, chân 14 GND, chân 15 +5V. Tay quay 4 trục có nút EMG, 6 trục không có; mỗi loại có 3 kiểu ngõ ra vi sai/NPN/PNP.

Pins 1 and 3 are tied to +5V (pin 15). Pin 2 <- OUT A (NPN output). Pin 4 <- OUT B (NPN output). The NPN outputs share the GND line (pin 14). Pin 5: not connected.
Pin 6: EMG. Pin 7: axis A. Pin 8: Z. Pin 9: Y. Pin 10: X. Pin 11/12/13: multiplier X1 / X10 / X100. Pin 14: GND. Pin 15: +5V.

metadata: {"chunk_key": "I-19", "doc_title": "Installation manual", "doc_version": "2024-04-25", "printed_page_start": 8, "printed_page_end": 11, "extraction": "text_layer+vision", "source_note": "PORT TABLE của tài liệu (tr.6-11) đánh số cổng lệch 1 so với Figure 2.1 và các sơ đồ 2.2-2.8 (vd RS485 ghi CN2, trục 1 ghi CN9). Typos in the manual's port table corrected: D2+ is the DIR+ of axis 2 (the table says axis 1 / D1-); D5- pairs with D5+ (the table says D3+)."}
content:
CN10-CN15 - servo / driver axis connectors, one per axis (pulse / direction control, Z-phase feedback).
Default axis assignment: CN10 = axis 1 (X), CN11 = axis 2 (Y), CN12 = axis 3 (Z), CN13 = axis 4 (A), CN14 = axis 5 (B), CN15 = axis 6 (C). The operator can customize the axis position settings.
Pins of the connector of axis n: Zn-, Zn+, Dn-, Dn+, Pn-, Pn+, FG.
- Zn- / Zn+: input pins of the Z-phase encoder signal (inverting / non-inverting differential).
- Dn- / Dn+: output pins of the DIR- / DIR+ differential signal, combined to control the direction.
- Pn- / Pn+: output pins of the PUL- / PUL+ differential signal, combined to send the pulse signal to the driver and servo motor.
- FG: connect with the shield wire.
Example: CN10 (axis 1) pins Z1-, Z1+, D1-, D1+, P1-, P1+, FG.
summary_vi: Mỗi trục servo dùng một cổng CN10-CN15 (trục 1-6 = X, Y, Z, A, B, C, có thể tùy chỉnh) với các chân Zn-/Zn+ (phản hồi pha Z), Dn-/Dn+ (hướng), Pn-/Pn+ (xung) và FG (chống nhiễu).

INPUT LOW wiring (Figure 2.2; connectors CN16, CN17, CN18; low-level / NPN-type inputs):
The common pin of every group of four inputs (CX.0 ... CX.5) is connected to the +24 V terminal of the 24 V supply. Each switch or sensor connects its input pin (X40-X47, X50-X57, X60-X67) to the 0 V terminal. Every input passes through a 3 kOhm resistor and an optocoupler; the input is active when it is pulled to 0 V.
Example: on CN16, CX.1 -> +24 V for X44-X47 and CX.0 -> +24 V for X40-X43.

metadata: {"chunk_key": "I-27", "doc_title": "Installation manual", "doc_version": "2024-04-25", "printed_page_start": 4, "printed_page_end": 26, "extraction": "text_layer+vision", "source_note": "Chunk tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn lắp đặt và User Guide; số lượng ngõ vào/ra đếm từ các cổng CN6-CN7, CN16-CN18."}
content:
F86 milling controller (QS Technology) - hardware summary compiled from the installation manual and the user guide:
- Supply: 24 V DC, power consumption 15 W; grounding compulsory.
- Axes: 6 pulse/direction axis connectors CN10-CN15 (X, Y, Z, A, B, C) with Z-phase feedback inputs, plus an axis-7 pulse/direction output on CN4.
- Digital inputs: 24 (X40-X47, X50-X57, X60-X67) on CN16-CN18; each group of four is wired as NPN (low) or PNP (high) through its common pin.
- Digital outputs: 16 (Y40-Y47, Y50-Y57) on CN6-CN7; DC 5-48 V, up to 1 A per pin.
- Spindle: analog output 0-10 V (DA.V) and 4-20 mA (DA.I) on CN4, or pulse/direction output.
- Ports: USB 2.0 (CN8), RS485 / I/O Link (CN3) for IO_LINK_32_V1.1_0722 expansion boards (32 inputs X300-X337 and 32 outputs Y300-Y337 per board), MPG handwheel DB15 (CN5; 4-axis or 6-axis; differential, NPN or PNP), Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n (optional).
- Data backup battery CR2032. Dimensions: see the dimension chunk of the user guide.

metadata: {"chunk_key": "G-11", "doc_title": "User guide", "doc_version": "2024-09-14", "printed_page_start": 11, "printed_page_end": 13, "extraction": "ocr+vision"}
content:
2.2 SENSOR CONNECTION PORT. Two sensor types are widely used: high input (PNP) and low input (NPN).
- High input (PNP): connect the CX pin to 0 V and use a high-input (PNP) sensor; its signal then becomes the controller input signal.
- Low input (NPN): connect the CX pin to 24 V and use a low-input (NPN) sensor.
- Connectors CN16, CN17 and CN18 can take either type (high input wiring: Figure 2-3; low input wiring: Figure 2-4).
Notes:
- CX.0, CX.1, CX.2, CX.3, CX.4, CX.5 are separate COM pins of the input signals.
- Wire input signals of the same type together.
- Do NOT wire two different voltage types of input signals to the controller at the same time.
- 2.2.3: refer to the reference connection table (2.9) before wiring, to avoid connecting a wrong signal and damaging the device.
summary_vi: Ngõ vào cảm biến CN16-CN18: cảm biến PNP (high input) thì nối chân CX vào 0V, cảm biến NPN (low input) thì nối CX vào 24V; không đấu lẫn hai loại, kiểm tra bảng tham chiếu 2.9 trước khi đấu.

- Input port 0: IN0-IN7 = X300-X307, common CX.0

- Input port 2: IN16-IN23 = X320-X327, common CX.2

3.1 MAIN PAGE (Figure 3-1, F86 controller main screen). The screen shows: screen name; date and time; program name; operation mode; coordinate systems, feedrate, spindle speed (programmed and actual) and the current tool in the spindle; spindle / rapid / feedrate override percentages; the function bar; manual data input; machine coordinate system.
The function bar opens the pages Coordinate, Program, Offset, Monitor and Message.
Notes:
- Distance to go: the remaining distance the machine needs to move to complete a command or machining program.

3.4 OFFSET PAGE. The place where the user sets the working values of the workpiece as well as the height and diameter of the cutting tool.
QS controllers provide 6 coordinate systems (listed in the manual as G54, G55, G57, G58, G59) and 18 extended workpiece coordinate systems from G59.1 (G54P7) to G59.12 (G54P18).
Offset features:
- Work set: set workpiece values.
- Tool set: set the height and diameter of the cutting tool.
- Tool NO: show the table of the current tools in the tool magazine.
- Apply AUX: assign the coordinates calculated by the middle function to a specified coordinate system.
- Apply MACH: assign the machine coordinates to a specified coordinate system.
- Middle function: calculate the center point from 4 points of a rectangular workpiece or 3 points of a circular workpiece.
Instruction parts: manual data input (3.4.1), assign machine / auxiliary coordinates (3.4.2), center point of 4-point and 3-point workpieces (3.4.3).

- Apply MACH: assign the machine coordinates to a specified coordinate system.
- Middle function: calculate the center point from 4 points of a rectangular workpiece or 3 points of a circular workpiece.

SYSTEM page features:
- DATA I/O: import and export data such as parameters, offsets, PLC and HMI.
- FIRMWARE: update and save the device firmware version.
- SYS.INIT: configure other features such as the time setting.

metadata: {"chunk_key": "G-63", "doc_title": "User guide", "doc_version": "2024-09-14", "printed_page_start": 88, "printed_page_end": 89, "extraction": "ocr+vision", "source_note": "Số thứ tự 'Stage' theo tài liệu; một số stage in gộp (3-4, 4-5, 6-7)."}
content:
3.11 TOOL LENGTH MEASUREMENT SENSOR. When M100 is called, the coolant is switched off and the Z axis, wherever it is, returns to the home position. Sequence:
Stage 2: the controller moves the X, Y axes and tool head to the measurement point set in parameters #14003 and #14004.
Stage 3: the Z axis moves quickly to the safety position (Z safe) set in #14005.
Next: the Z axis moves down and touches the sensor for the first time at the speed set in #14007.
Stage 4-5: after touching, the Z axis rises by the distance set in #14008.

content:
Tool length measurement errors (notes of 3.11):
- Stage 4-5: the Z axis moved the tool head to the touch position set in #14006 but did not touch the sensor -> the controller announces an error. Cause: the travel limit #14006 is not correct; check the value set in #14006.
- Stage 4-5: the Z axis rose by the value set in #14008 but the probe signal did not disappear -> error. Cause: the rise distance is too small or the sensor has a problem; check #14008 and the sensor.
- Stage 5-6: the Z axis moved the tool head to the touch position set in #14006 without touching the sensor -> error. Cause: the travel limit of #14006 is not correct (the manual tells the operator to refer to the value set in #14010).
- Stage 5-6: the Z axis rose by the value set in #14010 but the probe signal did not disappear -> error; the rise distance is too small or the sensor has a problem; check #14010 and the sensor.
- Stage 7: the Z axis moved the tool head to the touch position set in #14006 without touching the sensor -> error; the travel limit of #14006 is not correct, check #14006.
- Stage 10: if the deviation between the second and third touch exceeds #14012 the controller announces an error and no value is set into the H offset.

F86 installation overview - topics and where to find them (Installation manual: connector map and pinouts; User Guide chapter 2: wiring):
- Power supply: CN1 (FG, 0V, 24V), switching supply recommended.
- Inputs X40-X67: CN16-CN18, NPN (low) or PNP (high) per common group; reference I/O table (home, hard limits, start/hold, tool length sensor X56/X57, driver alarms, emergency X67).
- Outputs Y40-Y57: CN6-CN7 (5-48 V, up to 1 A per pin); default Y40-Y47 functions.
- Tool length sensor wiring: 3-wire, 4-wire (NPN/PNP), 6-wire (NPN/PNP).
- Servo axes pulse/direction + Z phase: CN10-CN15 (axes X, Y, Z, A, B, C).
- Inverter and analog spindle: CN4 (0-10 V, 4-20 mA).
- I/O Link expansion board: CN3 RS485 to IO_LINK_32_V1.1_0722 (32 inputs, 32 outputs per board).
- MPG handwheel: CN5 (DB15), 4-axis or 6-axis, differential / NPN / PNP.
- Home switch wiring (NPN / PNP), USB (CN8), keyboard (CN9), CR2032 battery, Wi-Fi antenna.
